timing: Requested after guided75/all-native pair-consistency outcomes were inspected. Exploratory extension; no preregistration claim. No production outcome tables may be computed before root freezes this proposal and independent labels are ready.

scope.candidate_pool: ALL75 native guided groups/dictionaries in each method for EVERY target category, regardless of interpreted/mixed/unclear status, old names or intended assignment.
scope.target_categories: All75 source-verified native target definitions, fixed before new crop-presence judgment. Training assignments identify target list only; independent new crop labels supply semantic presence.
scope.inputs: Only saved400 evaluation crops and signed196-position response arrays. No inference/training/new images.
scope.halves: Existing fixed200-description/200-audit image split from frozen run21 plans; no per-unit peak exclusion in concentration curves. Original fixed-pair coherence retains its separate inherited exclusions.

presence_labels.source: New independent crop-only presence judgments for all75 definitions in all400 planned crops; no response overlays, training masks, old labels or auto names as evidence.
presence_labels.denominators: Positive/negative response rates use determinate available yes/no crops only. Report planned, yes, no, unclear, missing and unreviewed counts per half. Never convert unclear/missing/unreviewed to no.
presence_labels.support_rule: At least5 determinate positives and10 determinate negatives in EACH half. Retain every category/method/q/budget low-support row with counts/status and null audit metrics; never drop low-support rows or fabricate scores.
presence_labels.label_lock: Root validates complete all400x75 label manifest, definitions and split hashes; retains raw provenance. Labels and annotation protocol are immutable at scoring.
presence_labels.qa: Fixed40-crop second pass, every75category cell; no original reviewer repeats their own crop; nominal named-pair Cohen and pooled Fleiss with support/confusion. Canonical outcomes preserved, explicit disagreement sensitivity.

response.primary: Arithmetic mean of the four largest signed saved responses among all196 positions per image/group; no clipping or zeroing.
response.secondary_pooling: None in this proposed extension; no post-result pooling choice.
response.validation: Exact frozen source/collection/weight/score hashes, IDs, split, finite shape400x196xnativebank and selectednative0..74. Source arrays read only.

calibration.threshold: Per target/category, group and q: numpy quantile(method='higher') of description-negative image responses. Detection is STRICT response>threshold; ties at threshold are negative.
calibration.ranking: Descending description balanced accuracy .5*(TPR+1-FPR) at the fixed threshold, ties ascending native group index. All75 candidates remain eligible.
calibration.selection: First min(budget,75) ranked groups; never sum dictionaries, decoder vectors, raw responses or scores. Selection uses description labels/responses only.
calibration.lock: Persist and SHA-lock all thresholds, full75 rankings, actual selections and description support before any audit scoring or audit alignment review.

description_alignment.target_meaning: Exact fixed native category definition in categories.json, locked before new labels. Never form or revise a meaning from audit outcomes.
description_alignment.views: Six highest signed mean-top4 responding DESCRIPTION crops per unique selected category/group, ties ascending imageID, excluding that unit's two known original peak-image IDs. No filtering for category presence or favorable images. Positive among top4 positions outlined; zero/negative filler never outlined.
description_alignment.rubric: Target requires dominant outlined content identifiable as the actual target object or part under its locked definition. Related_context means target-related scene/context with no dominant actual target support; other is identifiable different content; mixed retains competing target/non-target content; unclear includes missing/unreadable/zero-positive activity. A target elsewhere in the crop does not establish outlined target alignment.
description_alignment.lock: Immutable per-link description judgments and evidence hashes locked before that link's audit alignment review. These judgments never remove candidates or alter primary response-curve denominators.
description_alignment.priority: Review every supported category's primary q=.95 budget1 selected link first, then budget2/4/8 and q=.90 unique additions. Report actual links reviewed and all pending states.

metrics.primary: Audit OR positive coverage TP/Npositive and FPR FP/Nnegative at q=.95 for budgets1/2/4/8, per category. Equal weight per category for explicitly supported-category summaries, always report all75 support statuses.
secondary: Audit OR positive predictive precision TP/(TP+FP), undefined when no predictions
Mean pairwise positive-support Jaccard and mean pairwise negative-support Jaccard among selected groups; omit zero-union pairs from each mean, count informative/zero-union pairs, null if none
OR incremental positive/negative counts and rates when adding each group in locked ranking order
Unique positive/negative coverage per selected group: responses not covered by any other selected group at that budget; count and rate
Actual groups used, selected native IDs, thresholds and description rank/quality
metrics.overlap_interpretation: Overlap describes redundancy of thresholded crop responses, not purity or decoder-information recovery. Incremental/unique coverage is conditional on fixed thresholds and order.
metrics.coherence_support: Attach selected groups' existing corrected fixed3-pair semantic yes/no/unclear counts and shared meanings from immutable guided75/fullbank snapshot. Separate endpoint, never a candidate filter or a claim of target-specific alignment.
metrics.interpretation: CATEGORY-CONDITIONED RESPONSE CONCENTRATION. It does not alone prove semantic consolidation, category alignment, human interpretability, object-part coverage, training-label accuracy or information recovery.
metrics.uncertainty: One saved model run and reused crop pool. No model-run significance, confidence intervals from unknown bounds, or independence claim for shared images/groups. Unknown presence labels and low support explicitly limit generalization.

production_gates: Root-issued FROZEN_PROTOCOL.json plus matching SHA, referencing proposal SHA
Locked definitions, all400x75 presence labels and split/score provenance with matching hashes
Description-only selection lock derived under frozen protocol
Description alignment lock before audit alignment review; pending remains explicit
No audit outcome computation or reporting in preparation/synthetic tests
outputs: pure computational module and synthetic tests
After gates: description selection/view payload and immutable lock
After gates and labels: all75 percategory rows including low-support statuses, OR curves, overlap and incremental/unique support
Separate target-specific audit alignment status; pending until independently judged

audit_alignment.views: Six highest signed mean-top4 responding AUDIT crops per locked category/group link, ties imageID, excluding original peak IDs. Same fixed target definition and positive-top4 overlay. No favorable presence filtering.
audit_alignment.gate: Requires exact per-link description lock and unchanged target definition; no revision of meanings or canonical presence labels from audit responses.
audit_alignment.pending: Pending remains explicit. Curves may be reported as category-conditioned response concentration after presence/selection locks, never as completed semantic-consolidation evidence when target alignment is missing.

workflow: Freeze definitions, crop review and analytical protocol before new judgments/outcomes.
Complete and validate all400crop records with yes/no/unclear or missing across75 categories; lock canonical labels.
Select thresholds/ranks on description half only and lock complete selections before audit response scoring.
Produce every75-category support row; compute curves only for supported categories, with low-support values null.
Review fixed target-specific description evidence, prioritizing budget1 across every supported category; lock per link.
Review audit alignment only for locked links. Keep higher-budget or incomplete semantic evidence pending.
Report response concentration, generic group coherence and target-specific semantic alignment as separate components; no arbitrary composite winner.
reporting: Equal per-group generic coherence and equal per-category supported-category summaries only. No activity weighting in main claims. No category support selection based on response outcomes. No overall75-category claim when some categories have insufficient evidence.
